openssl_configuration.bootstrap_boundary: The caller imports hashlib before its own in-process manifest checks. Before every future Python launch, the root owner must independently authenticate the exact pinned application runtime, config, namespace, host premises and fixed launch environment using external custody checks. In-process pre/admission/final checks then detect observed drift; this is not a sandbox or a proof against changes between checks.
